purpose: Unique positive unital Q-linear extension of an effect valuation on an ordered rational module with an order unit.
boundaries: Requires the order-unit hypothesis explicitly; no matrix structure.
Three style-only linters are disabled for the uniform scalar-identity tactic blocks.

purpose: Rational n x n matrices with the quadratic-form preorder as an OrderedQUnit; order-unit bound, rank-one effects, trace representation of Q-linear functionals.
boundaries: The order is a preorder, not a partial order (skew matrices are null).
Real-symmetric rational carrier only; the matrix algebra and its order are supplied, not derived.

purpose: Rational Gram (LDL^T) decomposition of symmetric rational-PSD matrices in every dimension and trace positivity.
boundaries: PSD is tested on rational vectors only.
The number of Gram terms is existential; no diagonalisation over R is used.

purpose: Born representation: every effect valuation on rational matrices is trace(rho E) for a unique symmetric rational-PSD trace-one rho; converse for every state; nonvacuity.
boundaries: Effect additivity, positivity and normalisation are hypotheses; their operational justification is not addressed.
Complex (Gaussian-rational) Hermitian carrier not covered.

purpose: Parity frame function on rational rays of S^2 (Meyer-type): two-valued, sums to one on every orthogonal triple, not a quadratic form.
boundaries: Rays are integer triples, not all even, with square norm; parity_odd_smul formalises invariance under odd scalings, while the remark that every rational point of S^2 has a primitive representative is a docstring, not formalised.
Shows projection-only additivity on rational rays does not select the quadratic form; no claim about real orthonormal bases.
